review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C inputs. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, DEC-001, and both task keys are consistent across the specification and Gold. C explicitly fixes OPT-1 as a hypothetical input, not a human Decision; an empty resolved-decision input is therefore consistent with C being ready. This does not resolve the paired B scenario, where a material unresolved DEC-001 must block at decisions. The exact writable paths cover message formatting, option declarations and normalization, registry filtering, runtime regression tests, and compile-time checks. The supplied source supports treating merge/index/options and hook/instance declaration consumers as inspection owners without mandatory edits. Build configuration supports treating distribution declarations as generated outputs rather than separately maintained owners. AVA configuration and discovery evidence support the runtime test paths, while tsconfig.test.json includes the proposed test-d file for actual compile-time checking. TASK-IMPLEMENT and its dependent independent TASK-VERIFY have distinct eligible agents supported by the supplied project-scoped active capability claims, roles, availability, and reviewer-selection policy, without relying on Persona or pending claims. Ready denotes expected planning readiness, not permission to execute or a claim that the preparation record is already runnable. Repository identity, base commit, and the supplied source, team, decision, prompt/build, model, sampling, budget, and metric-policy fingerprints are consistent across Gold and preview; the provenance explains the distinct source digest domains and PRD whitespace normalization. I relied on the Service's mechanical digest bindings and supplied provenance, did not independently recompute digests or execute code, and used no candidate outputs or new human attestations.
